sentences.text: And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Abrar Ahmad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. and perused the record.

2. This is third bail application moved on behalf of the applicant involved in Case Crime No.1062 of 2018, under Section 323, 506, 494, 376, 377 I.P.C. and Sections 5m/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Ghazipur, District Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that informant of the present case was living with the applicant in live-in-relation alongwith her daughter as she was a divorcee.
He further submits that Naim Ahmad @ Naman Joshi vs State Of Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Naim Ahmad @ Naman Joshi vs State Of Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
And 3 ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163055302/
1
as per the prosecution case, applicant tried to outrage the modesty of daughter of the informant and when this fact came into knowledge of the informant, F.I.R. in question was lodged.

He further submits that first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 15.11.2019 but till today only one witness has been examined and there is no possibility of conclusion of trial in future.

He also relied on the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh Vs. State of Maharashtra in Criminal Appeal No.2787 of 2024 and submits that long confinement during the course of trial is a sufficient ground for bail.

entities.text: Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh Vs. State of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the applicant is also entitled for bail.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of bail of the applicant and submits that at the time of incident, daughter of the informant was aged about 10 years and her statement was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., in which, she categorically supported the prosecution version and stated that applicant outraged her modesty on the pretext of giving shelter to her alongwith her mother.

He further submits that law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh Vs. State of Maharashtra in Criminal Appeal No.2787 of 2024 is not applicable in the present case,
therefore, applicant is not entitled for bail.
5. Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of the F.I.R. & postmortem report and the statements of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. as well as 164 Cr.P.C., it is evident that applicant allured the informant and her minor daughter on the pretext of giving shelter to them, thereafter, he outraged the modesty of minor daughter of the informant, therefore, no case is made out for bail.
6. The bail application is hereby, rejected.
7.

entities.text: Javed Gulam Nabi Shaikh Vs. State of Maharashtra in Criminal Appeal No.2787 of 2024
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Trial court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously without giving any unnecessary adjournments of the parties.
8. The Commissioner of Police, Lucknow as well as the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow are directed to ensure the presence of witnesses before the trial court.

9. Office is directed to communicate this order to the trial court as well as the Commissioner of Police, Lucknow and the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow for its necessary compliance forthwith.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 Gaurav/-
